patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Ocean.io and Salesloft share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Ocean.io only if your buying job matches “Lookalike / similar-company prospecting with credit waterfall enrichment — from ~$0.063/cr” rather than Salesloft's shape. Choose Salesloft only if your buying job matches “Enterprise sales engagement / revenue generation platform — bi-directional CRM sync, seque” rather than Ocean.io's shape. Workflow advantage: Ocean.io leans data-enrichment; Salesloft leans sales-engagement. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Ocean.io and Salesloft share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Ocean.io is Lookalike / similar-company prospecting with credit waterfall enrichment — from ~$0.063/credit, ~$47/mo yearly headline.; Salesloft is Enterprise sales engagement / revenue generation platform — bi-directional CRM sync, sequencing, coaching; talk-to-sales pricing..
- Company-size focus: Ocean.io (small-business, mid-market) vs Salesloft (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Ocean.io-leaning data-enrichment vs Salesloft-leaning sales-engagement.
- Researched limits: Ocean.io — Lookalike/similar-company specialist — not a full contact mega-database or sequencer; Salesloft — Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core.

Limitations — Ocean.io: Lookalike/similar-company specialist — not a full contact mega-database or sequencer; Credit minimums and yearly packaging require modeling before comparing to seat tools; Salesloft: Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core; No published dollar pricing — talk-to-sales only.

Poor-fit cases: Ocean.io is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Lookalike/similar-company specialist — not a full contact mega-database or sequencer · Salesloft is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core · Avoid Ocean.io if you actually need Salesloft's motion (Enterprise sales engagement / revenue generation platform — bi-directional CRM s)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
